anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high, averaging above 9 across all intervals, which is above the number of CPU cores (8).
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, or generated opportunities, indicating potential issues with AI functionality.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, suggesting a potential issue with trading activity or strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart AI processes to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate and adjust trading strategies to ensure they are active and capable of executing trades effectively.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and address any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Conduct a diagnostic check on the AI system to identify and resolve issues preventing learning cycles and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI functionality is crucial for identifying trading opportunities and optimizing strategies.

recommendations.action: Review and test trading strategies to ensure they are correctly configured and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Active trading is essential for generating profit and achieving platform goals.
